openAtEnd allows other content only at the end of the list ("Additional content is allowed, but only at the end of the list", ElementDefinition.slicing.rules); HL7 6.10.4 does not report content before a slice.

A primitive's value is the JSON property itself (json.html#primitive: "the value of the primitive is represented as the property value"), so birthDate "2000-01-01" has one value and meets Patient.birthDate.value min 1; HL7 6.10.4 counts the value as absent.

An element context is a formal element id (defining-extensions.html#context), and an element matches the ids of the elements it instantiates and of its type and the type's ancestors; Resource does not derive from Element (R4, R5), so 'Element' does not name a resource's root. HL7 6.10.4 accepts 'Element' everywhere.

An element context names an element id, and a resource is also named by the interfaces its type implements; R5's ValueSet definition declares MetadataResource (structuredefinition-implements), so 'MetadataResource' names it. HL7 6.10.4 does not match the interfaces R5 declares.

Under -tx n/a HL7 6.10.4 does not evaluate that binding, matches both slices, and so finds no entry for Bundle.entry:composition (plan A, IPS all-sections multi-match, withdrawn).
